// Runtime fakes for i-errors.types.ts.
export function parseQuietHours(text) {
  const match = /^(\d{1,2})-(\d{1,2})$/.exec(text);
  if (match === null || Number(match[1]) > 23 || Number(match[2]) > 23) throw new RangeError(`invalid quiet hours: ${text}`);
  return Object.freeze({ from: Number(match[1]), to: Number(match[2]) });
}
export function createNotifier(hours) {
  let current = hours;
  return { setQuietHours: (next) => { current = next; }, quietHours: () => current };
}
